name: Natsume Gakuto
source:
"There are no boring people anywhere."

A reporter investigating a series of missing bodies. He is interested in Minazuki, who was at the scene of the missing body.

Although he uses polite language at work, he is casual with close friends.

[Translated from https://x.com/aikawanemu/status/1877744486131912727]
